correctness.rationale: For a nondegenerate noncircular ellipse a>b>0 and d>=1, the Joukowski parametrization z=Au+B/u and conjugate w=Bu+A/u gives ideal generator Q with bidegree (2,2). Hermitian bidegree-(d,d) restriction has kernel Q times Hermitian bidegree-(d-2,d-2), dimension (d-1)^2; hence the full intensity-profile real span has dimension (d+1)^2-(d-1)^2=4d. Its highest Fourier coefficient is necessarily real because only |z|^(2d) contributes, eliminating sin(2d theta). Discrete orthogonality at 4d equally spaced points determines all lower modes and recovers the top cosine iff cos(2d theta0) != 0, otherwise rank 4d-1. The two involutions of Joukowski coordinates generate a nonunit dilation, forcing any rational quotient p/q of equal-ellipse intensities to be constant unimodular. Independent exact symbolic Hermitian profile ranks at degrees 1,2,3 were 4,8,12 with kernel dimensions 0,1,4. The circle boundary d>=1 behaves differently (dimension 2d+1, phase nonuniqueness). The claim's linear full-profile minimum is not a nonlinear phase-retrieval lower bound.
